name: Nextenvios for WooCommerce
author: nextstationcl

sections.description:
Nextenvios is the platform Chilean last-mile delivery companies use to receive, route and deliver their customers’ packages. If your store ships with one of those companies, this plugin connects your store so that every order that meets your rules arrives by itself as a package, with the right commune and address. No typing, no spreadsheets.

  • One click to connect. Press “Connect” in your WordPress, sign in to Nextenvios and approve the access WooCommerce asks for.
  • You decide which orders go. By status (paid, on hold…), shipping method, excluded products or categories, the company’s coverage, and a pause switch for holidays. Each order shows in a column whether it goes and why.
  • Chilean communes at checkout. The City field becomes a list of communes, filtered by region, with only the communes your delivery company covers or all of them. If you already use another commune plugin, it detects it and stays out of the way.
  • A home delivery shipping method with a fixed price, a price per commune, or free shipping from an amount. Your buyers see “Home delivery” (or the name you choose), never “Nextenvios”.
  • Works with the block-based and the classic checkout, and with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Every option in the plugin explains what it does, what your buyers see and what happens if you change it. The Nextenvios → Help screen has the full guide.

External services

This plugin connects your store to Nextenvios (https://nextenvios.cl), a delivery management service operated by Nextstation SpA (Chile). It is required for the plugin to work.

  • When you press “Connect”, your browser is sent to the Nextenvios app (https://app.nextenvios.cl) with your store address. There you sign in and approve the access through WooCommerce’s own authorization screen, which creates a REST API key for Nextenvios.
  • When an order is created or changes, WooCommerce notifies Nextenvios (a webhook) and Nextenvios reads that order through the REST API. For each order that goes, Nextenvios uses only the recipient’s name, phone, address and commune, the order number and, if you allow it, the buyer’s note. It never uses the buyer’s email, tax id (RUT), payment details or product prices.
  • Once a day, the plugin asks Nextenvios (https://integraciones.nextenvios.cl) for the list of communes your delivery company covers, and tells it the plugin version and whether sending is paused. No buyer data is sent in these requests.

Nextenvios terms of service: https://app.nextenvios.cl/legal/terminos — Privacy policy: https://app.nextenvios.cl/legal/privacidad

You can revoke the access at any time by disconnecting in Nextenvios → Home, or by deleting the key in WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (Plugins → Add New → search “Nextenvios”, or upload the zip).
  2. Go to Nextenvios → Home and press Connect with Nextenvios. Sign in with the supplier account your delivery company gave you, confirm, and approve the access.
  3. In WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping, add the method “Delivery with…” to the zones where the company delivers.
  4. Review Nextenvios → Orders, Communes and Shipping. The defaults are safe.

Requirements: WooCommerce 8.9 or later, https, and permalinks other than “Plain”.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Nextenvios account?

Yes: a supplier account, given by the delivery company that works with you through Nextenvios.

An order did not arrive. What do I do?

Look at the Nextenvios column in WooCommerce → Orders: it tells you why the order does not go. Fix it and use the bulk action “Resend to Nextenvios”. Resending never creates a duplicate package.

I already use another plugin for Chilean communes.

The plugin detects it and, by default, does not touch the communes. Orders still go to Nextenvios, reading the commune from the City field (or from the other plugin’s field, if you tell it which one).

What happens if a buyer cancels?

Nextenvios marks the package as cancelled in the store and the plugin adds a note to the order; tell your delivery company so it does not deliver it.

My hosting does not let Nextenvios in.

Use “Check my hosting” in Nextenvios → Home. Some hostings remove the Authorization header; the Help screen shows the line to add to your .htaccess file.
